corporate_announcements.pdf_extracted_text: 6th November, 2026 BSE Limited National Stock Exchange of India Limited Department of Corporate Services Listing Department Phiroze Jeejeebhoy Towers Exchange Plaza Dalal Street Bandra-Kurla Complex Mumbai 400 001 Bandra (East), Mumbai 400 051 Scrip Code: 500575 NSE Symbol: VOLTAS Dear Sirs, Sub: Outcome of Board Meeting - Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026 Dear Sirs, The Board of Directors at its Meeting held today, i.e., 6th November, 2026, inter alia, approved the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results of the Company for quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. The signed Financial Results along with the Limited Review Reports issued by the Statutory Auditors are enclosed. A copy of the Press Release is also enclosed. The above information will also be made available on the website of the Company at www.voltas.in. The Board Meeting commenced at 11.00 a.m. and concluded at 4.15 p.m. Thanking you Yours faithfully, For Voltas Limited Ratnesh Rukhariyar Company Secretary & Compliance Officer Encl.: a/a Corporate Management Office Registered Office Voltas House 'A’ Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar Road Chinchpokli Mumbai 400 033 India Tel 91 22 66656290 66656258 e-mail shareservices@voltas.com website www.voltas.in Corporate Identity Number L29308MH1954PLC009371 Voltas Delivers Steady Q2 FY27 Performance, on the back of market leadership and Execution Excellence Mumbai, 6 November 2026: The Board of Directors of Voltas Limited, India's No. 1 Air Conditioning brand from the Tata Group, announced the consolidated financial results (including the consolidated segment report) of the Company for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. Voltas continued to reinforce its leadership in the Indian Room Air Conditioner (RAC) market during Q2 FY27, with the RAC business recording 32% volume growth during the quarter. The Company maintained its No. 1 position in the industry, achieving a market share of 17.4% for the year to date ended September 2026, with a 4.2% lead over its nearest competitor. The performance reflects the continued strength of the Voltas brand, its product portfolio, extensive distribution network and sustained focus on market execution. The Unitary Cooling Products business recorded 29% revenue growth during the quarter, led by RAC, while improving profitability despite commodity and currency related cost pressures. Voltbek continued to expand its presence in the home appliances market, achieving record Q2 sales and further strengthening its market position in Washing Machines and Refrigerators. The Electro-Mechanical Projects and Services business maintained order momentum, supported by an order pad exceeding ₹6,800 crore, providing revenue visibility. The Engineering Products and Services segment registered 30+% growth, supported by Mining and Construction Equipment and Textile Machinery. Across its businesses, Voltas continued to focus on market competitiveness, product innovation, distribution expansion, cost optimisation and disciplined execution, while strengthening the foundations for sustainable and profitable growth. Consolidated Results for the quarter ended 30th September,2026: For the quarter ended 30th September,2026, Voltas recorded Consolidated Total Income of ₹ 2,746 crores, compared to ₹ 2,412 crores in the same period last year. Profit Before Tax of ₹ 83 crores vs ₹ 54 crores in Q2 FY26. Profit After Tax of ₹ 48 crores compared to ₹ 32 crores last year

Key Consolidated Highlights: Particulars (INR Cr) Q2 FY27 Q2 FY26 YoY H1 FY27 H1 FY26 YoY` Revenue from operations 106.3 82.7 28.7% 180.7 124.2 45.5% EBITDA* 22.8 12.8 77.8% 37.1 18.9 96.2% EBITDA Margins 20.9% 15.4% 550 bps 20.1% 15.1% 500 bps PAT 16.0 8.3 92.3% 25.7 11.5 123.1% PAT Margins 14.7% 10.0% 470 bps 14.2% 9.3% 490 bps EPS Basic 4.46 2.88 7.38 4.28 *EBITDA includes Other Income Performance Highlights for Q2 FY27: • Revenue from Operations stood at ₹ 106.3 Cr, an increase of 28.7% YoY • EBITDA came in at ₹ 22.8 Cr, with an EBITDA margin of 20.9% (up 550 bps YoY) • Profit After Tax stood at ₹ 16.0 Cr, with a PAT margin of 14.7% (up 470 bps YoY) Commenting on the results, Kochouseph Thomas Chittilappilly, founder, vice chairman & WTD, Veegaland Developers Limited said, At Veegaland, our focus remains on strengthening our presence across Kerala's key residential markets while continuing to build a differentiated portfolio of quality homes with biophilic designs. We believe that a strong understanding of local markets, eco-friendly building techniques and a commitment to quality are critical to building a sustainable customer confidence in the long-term. As we move forward, we remain focused on robust project execution, operational efficiencies and continuous improvement to support our next phase of growth. Thanking you, Yours faithfully, For SKF India (Industrial) Limited _______________ Poorva Bang Company Secretary & Compliance Officer SKF India (Industrial) Limited Registered office: Chinchwad Gaon, Chinchwad, Pune 411033, Maharashtra, India Tel: +91 (20) 6611 2501, Fax no: +91 (20) 6611 2396, Email id: industrialindia@skf.com CIN: L28140PN2024PLC236396 Press Release Q2 FY2026-27 Financial Results QUARTERLY HIGHLIGHTS ■ Revenue from operations at Rs. 10,428.6 million, reflecting a 7.4% growth compared to Rs. 9,707.7 million in the previous quarter ■ Profit before tax stands at Rs. 1,343.7 million compared to Rs 869.2 million in the previous quarter ■ Continued demand traction across heavy industries, wind, aftermarket and exports SKF India (Industrial) Limited announces financial results for Q2 FY2026-27 Pune, November 04 2026: SKF India (Industrial) Limited (NSE: SKFINDUS | BSE: 544572), India’s leading technology and solutions provider of bearings and units, condition monitoring, and services, today announced its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. During this quarter, SKF India (Industrial) Limited reported revenue from operations of Rs. 10,428.6 million with profit before tax at Rs. 1,343.7 million, demonstrating continued execution strength against a backdrop of healthy industrial demand and steadfast operational efficiency. FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS (Q2 FY 26-27) Particulars (Rs. mn) Q2 FY27 Q2 FY26* YoY % Q1 FY27 QoQ % Revenue from Operations 10,428.6 8,130.6 28.3% 9,707.7 7.4% Profit before Tax 1,343.7 1,013.6 32.6% 869.2 54.6% PBT Margin (%) 12.9% 12.5% 42 bps 9.0% 393 bps Profit after Tax 1,034.8 769.3 34.5% 619.2 67.1% PAT Margin (%) 9.9% 9.5% 46 bps 6.4% 354 bps * Extracted by the management from the financial Information of SKF India Limited before demerger MANAGEMENT COMMENTARY Sujeeth Pai, MD, SKF India (Industrial) Limited, said, “Our Q2 performance reflects strong industrial demand and disciplined execution of our strategy. Revenue grew 7.4% sequentially to Rs. 10,428.6 million, while PBT increased 54.6%, strengthening PBT margin to 12.9%. Customer proximity, deeper localisation and application-led innovation remain our priorities for sustaining profitable growth. Looking ahead, our ambition is to enable a more reliable, efficient and competitive Indian industry, creating lasting value for customers and shareholders. India’s industrial and infrastructure story is in its early chapters, and SKF India (Industrial) is built to grow with it.
